short: Engineering 2D Multifunctional Ultrathin Bismuthene for Mult
title: Engineering 2D Multifunctional Ultrathin Bismuthene for Multiple Photonic Nanomedicine

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Cancer phototherapy needs one agent that combines photothermal, photodynamic and imaging functions. Ultrathin 2D bismuthene can serve as a single agent for PA/CT-guided synergistic PTT and PDT.
states.detail: Absorbed: h1 (HYP/need), h2 (HYP/hypothesis), d1 (DES/base_system), c1 (PRC/synthesis), c2 (PRC/synthesis)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Bismuthene nanosheets are rhombohedral metallic Bi. Bismuthene forms thin 2D plates about 250-350 nm across and ~14 nm thick

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Bismuthene has a narrow optical band gap of about 0.69 eV. Bismuthene absorbs strongly at 808 nm, extinction coefficient ~6.4 L g-1 cm-1.
states.detail: Absorbed: p1 (PRP/value), p2 (PRP/value), p3 (PRP/value), p4 (PRP/value), m1 (MEC/pathway)

states.title: Performance state
states.head: BNs-BSA plus 660 and 808 nm lasers eradicate 4T1 tumours with no regrowth over 22 days

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: Ultrathin bismuthene is a single multifunctional agent for PA/CT-guided synergistic PTT/PDT of tumours

nodes.note: bulk Bi reference itself carries weak bands near 340 and 490 cm-1 surface-sensitive; metallic core with oxidised surface is consistent

nodes.title: ASSAY:tumour, F3, F5
nodes.head: IR thermal images: dispersion temperature rises faster and higher with concentration 25-200 ug mL-1; water stays cool. Cooling-curve fit of -ln(theta) vs time gives tau_s = 133.4 s and eta = 19.4%.
nodes.solves: Bismuthene converts 808 nm light to heat with ~19% efficiency, rising with dose and power
nodes.note: F3d curves (cited at figure level, cue conflict) give ~58 C at 200 ug mL-1 vs ~31 C water after 6 min at 1.5 W cm-2; F3f/F3g give ~38-58 C for 0.5-1.5 W cm-2; F3i: four on/off cycles peak at ~55-58 C with no marked decline last -ln(theta) point falls below the fitted line caption says 6 min irradiation; the plotted axis ends at 5 min
nodes.detail: o10: IR thermal images: dispersion temperature rises faster and higher with concentration 25-200 ug mL-1; water stays cool; o11: Cooling-curve fit of -ln(theta) vs time gives tau_s = 133.4 s and eta = 19.4%; o13: Under 808 nm, BNs-BSA tumours heat to ~49 C within 5 min vs ~41 C with PBS
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for p3 (o10, o11, o13).

nodes.title: evidence, F3
nodes.head: Under 660 nm, DPBF absorbance falls to ~0.73 in 30 min with bismuthene vs ~0.93 in water
nodes.solves: Bismuthene generates ROS under 660 nm irradiation
nodes.note: y axis reads absorbance at 421 nm while the caption says 470 nm; water control also bleaches ~7%; F3a spectra fall monotonically with time
nodes.detail: o12: Under 660 nm, DPBF absorbance falls to ~0.73 in 30 min with bismuthene vs ~0.93 in water
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for p4 (o12).

nodes.title: ASSAY:tumour, F5
nodes.head: 808 nm-only tumours regrow from about day 14 in most mice; combined-treatment tumours stay at zero
nodes.solves: 808 nm hyperthermia and 660 nm ROS act together: ROS removes the residual cells that heating alone leaves to regrow
nodes.note: F5d restored by judge (false micrograph cue). 808 nm-only: 4 of 5 curves regrow from day ~12-17 (to ~270-690 mm3 at day 22), one stays at zero; 660 nm-only curves track the controls with slower growth
nodes.detail: o15: 808 nm-only tumours regrow from about day 14 in most mice; combined-treatment tumours stay at zero
nodes.necessity_reason: Only figure-backed support with image_support shown for m1 (o15).

nodes.note: signal dips to 0.13 at 1 h, below the pre-injection 0.26 WBC ~50 vs ~35 (1e8 L-1) with non-overlapping error bars; n = 3
